free_parameters.name: seed
free_parameters.why: fixes the Sequence tier draw so the run is deterministic

free_parameters.name: max_model_len
free_parameters.why: model limit needed by BaseScheduler; not used by the target decision

free_parameters.name: chunk_size
free_parameters.why: scheduler chunk budget; only needs to be positive so the decode loop is entered

free_parameters.name: block_size
free_parameters.why: cache block size used consistently for the Sequence and the block manager

free_parameters.name: num_gpu_blocks
free_parameters.why: CPU block pool size; enough for allocation and for can_append_slot to hold

free_parameters.name: prompt_len
free_parameters.why: small prompt that fits one block and is fully processed before scheduling

free_parameters.name: eos_token_id
free_parameters.why: ordinary end-of-sequence id stored on the Sequence; unused at the target

free_parameters.name: arrival_time
free_parameters.why: sequence is already present in the running queue, so arrival ordering is irrelevant
